source: ECharts 6.1 dist (echarts.js), node SSR, SVG renderer
notes: Every option has animation false; the clock is fake.
A step naming a toolbox icon points at its rect centre (rounded); one naming an item at its layout point (rounded).
The rows are the data the series holds after its filter (data index i, raw index raw).
Every option is given upstream's default palette (color), so the port, whose default is its skin's, starts from the same series colours.
brushselected comes after the event of the action whose update ran the visual stage (the pending brushSelect is flushed after it).

scenarios.note: a scatter on value axes: rect, a moved rect, polygon, lineX and lineY select by the point selector; the default visuals (out of brush the disabled colour, in it liftZ 5)
vertical bars: a rect touching some bars, a polygon crossing them (its edges against the bars), lineX, lineY over the bars' lengths
horizontal bars on a category y axis: lineY and rect
a candlestick: lineX, rect, polygon against its brushRect (lowest to highest, a candle wide)
no finder (the global panel): an effectScatter selected, a line (no brushSelector) and a pie (no coordinate system) not
inBrush / outOfBrush written: colour, opacity, symbol, symbolSize, colorAlpha; a merge that writes outOfBrush drops inBrush (replaceVisualOption); seriesIndex
two grids, xAxisIndex 'all': a cover in the left grid controls only the series on it
a slider dataZoom filters the scatter: the selected indices are the raw ones of the items left
brushLink 'all': a scatter's selection spreads by data index to a bar and a line (whose symbols take the visuals)
brushLink [0, 2]: series 1 checks its own items; two brush components (the batch has both; the first one's throttle)
no brush component: every action that runs the visual stage fires brushselected with an empty batch; setOption, highlight and select do not
debounce 300: the batch is the latest call's; a brush action from coordRange; a legend toggle hides a series, which leaves the batch
the preprocessor adds a toolbox with rect, polygon, keep and clear: rect on, a cover, keep (multiple), a second cover, polygon, clear, rect off
a brush's own toolbox list added to the author's toolbox: lineX, lineY, clear beside saveAsImage
a merge that brings a brush: the toolbox it adds has no buttons (not new); a notMerge does; a written type list deduplicated
an inside dataZoom pans until the brush takes globalPan; brushing draws a cover and pans nothing; off again, it pans
a graph's roam pans until the brush takes globalPan
a scatter on another grid drawn over the brush's panel: a press on its symbol starts no cover and gets no crosshair; once the panel's grid is higher it does

guards.mutation: a rect touching a bar does not intersect it
a polygon's bars tested by corners only, not by its edges
every area controls every series (no controlSeries)
a brushLink index list links nothing
a bar's layout range is not put in order (negative heights)
the clear button is never emphasised
